item.title: Amazon Driver Double Parked On Natio
item.description: by Anonymous Monday around 5pm. Way to double park and just leave your stupid ass Amazon vehicle there to block our bus from getting through, backing up traffic for God knows how far (and for like ten full minutes, if not longer). Think about how many people you made late that didn't have to be, if you had just pulled up a hundred feet to one of the open parking spaces. That's why you follow the rules of the road.
